headline: Statement Says Putin Was Told to End the War
deck: Merz said Europe expected to be represented in talks with Russia, but gave no date for the next meeting.
body: A statement said President Vladimir Putin had been told directly that he needed to stop the war immediately, as the conflict approached its fifth anniversary. [E1]
The paper’s 19 November coverage reported the first trilateral meeting and Putin’s statement that the three countries had shared interests in settling regional conflicts including Ukraine. [E3][E4]

After a meeting of Ukraine’s allies in Berlin, Merz said talks with Russia including European representatives were expected soon; he named Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Poland and Italy, but gave no concrete date. [E2]

evidence_box.fragment: I made very clear to President Putin directly yesterday that he needs to stop his war and he needs to stop it now. This has now gone on for longer than I've been Prime Minister. This is a conflict approaching its five-year anniversary.

evidence_box.fragment: Of course we are prepared to hold talks with Russia, we have always said this. These talks are now set to take place soon," Merz said after a meeting of Ukraine's allies in Berlin . He did not give a concrete date for the next talks, but said Europe's interests would be represented by Germany, France, the UK, Poland and Italy.
